en.headline: Hong Kong International Airport hosts Airports Council regional meeting
en.dek: Leaders from 20 airports discussed infrastructure investment, capacity and sustainability as the two-day Asia-Pacific and Middle East Regional Council session ended on Thursday.
body: Hong Kong International Airport hosted the Airports Council International Asia-Pacific and Middle East Regional Council meeting, which concluded on Thursday after two days of discussions among leaders from 20 airports.

Airport Authority Chairman Fred Lam Tin-fuk, who also serves as First Vice-President of the Regional Council, chaired the session. Topics included the Council’s 2027-2030 strategic plan, global airport development priorities and prospects for infrastructure investment.

Lam said the Authority welcomed the members to Hong Kong amid a challenging operating environment for the industry. He noted that discussions on infrastructure, capacity, innovation and sustainability are key to airports’ continued development. Hong Kong last hosted the Regional and World Annual General Assemblies in 2019. He added that the airport will continue close cooperation with the Regional Council to promote sustainable growth and regional connectivity.

zh.headline: 香港國際機場主辦國際機場協會亞太中東區域理事會會議
zh.dek: 來自20個機場的領袖出席為期兩日的會議，周四圓滿結束，討論基建投資、擴容及可持續發展等議題。
body: 香港國際機場主辦國際機場協會亞太及中東區域理事會會議2026，會議為期兩日，於周四圓滿結束。來自全球20個機場的領袖出席，共同探討航空業重要議題。
香港機場管理局主席林天福以國際機場協會亞太及中東區域理事會第一副主席身分主持會議。議程包括協會2027至2030年策略計劃、全球機場發展及政策倡議重點，以及機場基建投資前景。
林天福表示，機管局歡迎區域理事會成員來港。全球航空業營運環境持續面對挑戰，業界領袖就基建、擴容、創新及可持續發展進行討論。香港國際機場曾於2019年主辦區域及全球周年大會。他指機場將繼續與區域理事會緊密合作，推動可持續增長及區域互聯互通。
